answer: Each identity leases a wharf berth, stakes 75 credits, mounts a keyed prism. The beacon shines through the prism past a velvet baffle; the identity files the angle. Auditors recompute it from the public prism-angle table; a 2-degree error, reused serial, or shared baffle burns the bond. First filing 38; the kth fake pays 38+6(k-1), berths lease in order, prisms cut fresh, so the 1000th pays 6032, 1000 fakes 3,035,000, 75,000 locked. An honest operator pays 38 once, bond back after a clean epoch. A rented-prism ring fails: serial and baffle weave bind to one berth, sharing burns both bonds.
